reuse.why: Fintegra shares linking and downloading implementations with existing providers, and replacement reuses extracted unlink logic, but account listing introduces another copy.

duplication.why: The main new workflows are shared, but fintegraAccounts duplicates akahuAccounts and claimBankAccountLink repeats target-existence validation retained in the link handlers.

placement.why: Link orchestration, transaction downloading, server configuration and provider models remain in their established modules.

scope.why: The changes address the requested linking rules and provider integration, although the additional fintegra-accounts endpoint exceeds the specified linking and transaction API.

maintainability.why: Shared policy and unlink helpers simplify ownership, but the new provider-specific union and unrestricted provider string leave the existing BankSyncProviders definition disconnected from the integration.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers use claimBankAccountLink, bank lookup uses findOrCreateBank, and both unlink paths use clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining listing and target-validation duplication is direct; the extracted linking, downloading and clearing implementations provide actual sharing.

abstraction_drift.where: Step 4 adds replaceExistingLink and its refusal-versus-clear branch to the shared link policy; every provider continues through that policy.
